status: Great Furnace recording-ready; Colossus encounter integrated.

pike.name: Foreman Pike
pike.role: A Hollowed overseer following strict production and safety orders

martin.name: Martin
martin.role: A worker organizer with a dry sense of humor and a plan for every friend

gf.pike.first.text: Production is interrupted. State your work station and reason for entry. Workers without a task return to the line.

choices.text: A pipe is leaking. Your schedule says that needs a patrol.
Where are the maintenance records?
Open the gate. I am getting the workers out.
I will check my work order.

voice.speaker: pike
voice.emotion: Flat male voice. Almost normal, with no anger or warmth.
voice.direction: Flat male voice. Almost normal, with no anger or warmth.
voice.context: Great Furnace. Stop the Legion weapon supply and rescue workers. No Bladeborn confirmation or final-cut knowledge. Inspection gate

gf.pike.records.text: West maintenance bay. All faults must be checked against the shift schedule. Unsupported claims delay production.

choices.text: I will check it.

voice.speaker: pike
voice.emotion: Precise and empty. A memorized instruction.
voice.direction: Precise and empty. A memorized instruction.
voice.context: Great Furnace. Stop the Legion weapon supply and rescue workers. No Bladeborn confirmation or final-cut knowledge. The rules can be used

choices.text: About my work order...

voice.speaker: pike
voice.emotion: No threat in the voice; that makes it worse.
voice.direction: No threat in the voice; that makes it worse.
voice.context: Great Furnace. Stop the Legion weapon supply and rescue workers. No Bladeborn confirmation or final-cut knowledge. Waiting at the gate

gf.pike.proof.text: Pressure loss confirmed. Inspection takes priority. Gate patrol: examine the west pipe. Worker passage is cleared for maintenance.

choices.text: I will see to the passage.

effects.title: Past the foreman
effects.text: Pike sent the gate patrol to inspect the leaking pipe. Martin is in the break room beyond the gate.

voice.speaker: pike
voice.emotion: He obeys his standing orders, not a personal appeal.
voice.direction: He obeys his standing orders, not a personal appeal.
voice.context: Great Furnace. Stop the Legion weapon supply and rescue workers. No Bladeborn confirmation or final-cut knowledge. A valid fault report

gf.pike.alarm.text: Unassigned movement. Gate patrol: stop this worker. Production must continue.

choices.text: Then I will make my own way.

effects.title: Open the worker gate
effects.text: Clear the gate patrol, then use the handle beside the gate. Martin is in the break room beyond it.

voice.speaker: pike
voice.emotion: Same flat delivery. Do not shout or cackle.
voice.direction: Same flat delivery. Do not shout or cackle.
voice.context: Great Furnace. Stop the Legion weapon supply and rescue workers. No Bladeborn confirmation or final-cut knowledge. Combat entrance

gf.pike.done.text: The schedule does not allow further discussion.

voice.speaker: pike
voice.context: Great Furnace. Stop the Legion weapon supply and rescue workers. No Bladeborn confirmation or final-cut knowledge. Orders complete

gf.martin.first.text: You stopped the hammers. We heard the silence all the way down here. Best thing this place has made in years. Now help me get everyone out before someone decides we should fix it.

choices.text: What is the safest way out?
We should leave right now.

voice.speaker: martin
voice.emotion: Warm male voice, tired but quick. A little smile at the joke.
voice.direction: Warm male voice, tired but quick. A little smile at the joke.
voice.context: Great Furnace. Stop the Legion weapon supply and rescue workers. No Bladeborn confirmation or final-cut knowledge. Worker break room

gf.martin.plan.text: Open the worker passage first. Then choose: ring the work bell and the shelter bell to get everyone out now, or climb west and stop the transport chain. That pulls patrols away. If you do that, ring the shelter bell first so we know to leave quietly.

choices.text: Get them out now. I can handle the patrols.

effects.title: Get the workers out
effects.text: Open the worker passage on the lower western floor. Ring the work bell there, then the shelter bell in the break room. The patrols will remain on the lower route.

choices.text: I will stop the transport chain first.

effects.title: A quieter escape
effects.text: Open the worker passage. Take the western climbing route to stop the transport chain. Then ring the shelter bell in the break room, followed by the work bell below. This draws patrols away from the workers.

voice.speaker: martin
voice.emotion: Practical, protective. Neither choice is foolish.
voice.direction: Practical, protective. Neither choice is foolish.
voice.context: Great Furnace. Stop the Legion weapon supply and rescue workers. No Bladeborn confirmation or final-cut knowledge. Two evacuation routes

gf.martin.early.text: Then open the passage west of the worker floor. Work bell first, shelter bell second. They will run when they hear it. You keep the guards busy. No one has to be a hero twice today.

choices.text: I will clear their path.

effects.title: Get the workers out
effects.text: Open the worker passage on the lower western floor. Ring the work bell there, then the shelter bell in the break room. The patrols remain on the lower route.

voice.speaker: martin
voice.context: Great Furnace. Stop the Legion weapon supply and rescue workers. No Bladeborn confirmation or final-cut knowledge. Direct evacuation

gf.martin.quiet.text: The brake is above the west loading floor. Expect guards. Once the chain stops, shelter bell first, work bell second. The noise should cover our feet. Most of us are very good at leaving work.

choices.text: Stay ready.

voice.speaker: martin
voice.emotion: A quick dry joke, then back to work.
voice.direction: A quick dry joke, then back to work.
voice.context: Great Furnace. Stop the Legion weapon supply and rescue workers. No Bladeborn confirmation or final-cut knowledge. Quiet evacuation

gf.martin.wait.text: I am keeping count. Every worker, every time. What have you found?

choices.text: They are safe. How do I stop the furnace?

effects.title: Cool the furnace crossing
effects.text: Trace the pipes at the cooling controls: fill the round tank, open the square channel, drain the triangle tray. The crossing rises only after the workers are safe.

choices.text: These writings mention Sunspire Palace.

effects.title: A route toward Sunspire
effects.text: The seized writings describe a hidden wisdom orb in Sunspire Palace that answers one question. Martin knows sailors on Storm Coast who may help reach the sea cliffs below the palace. First, get past the Colossus.

choices.text: There is something alive in that work cage.
Keep them together. I will be back.

voice.speaker: martin
voice.emotion: Attentive and focused. He remembers people, not numbers.
voice.direction: Attentive and focused. He remembers people, not numbers.
voice.context: Great Furnace. Stop the Legion weapon supply and rescue workers. No Bladeborn confirmation or final-cut knowledge. Progress and next task

gf.martin.cool.text: Round tank, square channel, triangle tray. The old signs still show the order. Cool the crossing and it will rise. That gets you to the Colossus. Its armor drinks heat from this place. Cooling should do more than make the walk pleasant.

choices.text: What is in the high office?
I will follow the pipes.

voice.speaker: martin
voice.emotion: Calm technical advice in everyday words.
voice.direction: Calm technical advice in everyday words.
voice.context: Great Furnace. Stop the Legion weapon supply and rescue workers. No Bladeborn confirmation or final-cut knowledge. The Colossus approach

gf.martin.office.text: Seized papers. The guards carry them up the east gallery and lock them away. I know which stairs they use. I do not know what the papers say. If the Legion hides something that carefully, I would like a look.

choices.text: I will search it.

effects.title: Confiscated writings
effects.text: The command office stands above the eastern gallery. Search its desk. The guards have been locking seized papers there.

voice.speaker: martin
voice.emotion: Curious, with a sharp edge of resentment.
voice.direction: Curious, with a sharp edge of resentment.
voice.context: Great Furnace. Stop the Legion weapon supply and rescue workers. No Bladeborn confirmation or final-cut knowledge. The high office

gf.martin.pages.text: A palace above the sea cliffs. And an orb that answers one question? I thought these were shipping papers. I know sailors on Storm Coast. They will know the crossing. Get us past that giant, and I will send word. You will not have to find the way alone.

choices.text: One question. We had better make it count.
Thank you. I could use the help.

voice.speaker: martin
voice.scene: The writings reveal the next destination
voice.emotion: Genuine surprise. He learns the secret from the papers now.
voice.direction: Genuine surprise. He learns the secret from the papers now.
voice.context: Great Furnace. Stop the Legion weapon supply and rescue workers. No Bladeborn confirmation or final-cut knowledge. The writings reveal the next destination

gf.martin.hope.text: You came here to stop their weapons. You are leaving with people willing to help you. I think that is the better trade. We will keep the way back open.

choices.text: I will deal with the Colossus.

voice.speaker: martin
voice.emotion: Quiet hope; no prophecy or knowledge of the player’s bloodline.
voice.direction: Quiet hope; no prophecy or knowledge of the player’s bloodline.
voice.context: Great Furnace. Stop the Legion weapon supply and rescue workers. No Bladeborn confirmation or final-cut knowledge. A growing circle of help

gf.martin.cage.text: They use its heat to move the cage. It snaps because they keep hurting it. Close the heat feed, open the little air vent, then release the lock. It might bite you anyway. But at least it will be an honest bite.

choices.text: I will try.

voice.speaker: martin
voice.context: Great Furnace. Stop the Legion weapon supply and rescue workers. No Bladeborn confirmation or final-cut knowledge. The captive fire creature

effects.title: A real maintenance fault
effects.text: A cracked pipe leaks beside the west maintenance bay. Pike may accept a fault report if it follows the work schedule.

effects.title: Inspection comes first
effects.text: The work schedule orders gate patrols to inspect any confirmed pressure loss before returning to guard duty. The leaking pipe is beside this bay.

effects.title: The worker passage is open
effects.text: The lower passage is open. Follow the bell order agreed with Martin to guide the workers to shelter.

effects.title: The workers are safe
effects.text: Both bells sounded in order. The workers have reached shelter and opened a service crossing. Find the cooling controls north of the furnace.

effects.title: The workers are safe
effects.text: Both bells sounded in order. The workers have reached shelter and opened a service crossing. Find the cooling controls north of the furnace.

effects.title: Follow the water
effects.text: The cooling diagram shows a round tank feeding a square channel, then a triangle-marked drain. Fill, open, drain. The safety system empties the tanks if the order is wrong.

effects.title: The hidden wisdom of Sunspire
effects.text: Confiscated pages describe Sunspire Palace above remote sea cliffs. In a protected chamber, a living orb of wisdom answers one question. The pages describe a sea approach from Storm Coast. Finding the orb may reveal how to reach the Abyss King. Show Martin the route marks.

effects.title: A cooler approach
effects.text: The upper pressure valve opens a maintenance passage below the walkway. Less pressure now reaches the Colossus floor.

effects.title: The cooling-box plate
effects.text: Three marks run against the water flow: triangle, square, circle. The sealed cooling box has the same three buttons.

effects.title: Something alive in the cage
effects.text: A small fire creature is trapped in the work cage. Its pipes are marked: heat feed, air vent, lock. Stop feeding heat before letting the cage breathe. Martin may know more.

effects.title: Cinder is free
effects.text: The fire creature is free. Reach the Colossus room to keep Cinder as a companion. It will then appear in the Beastkeeper’s menu.
